title: Reading the Allowance Loaded for a Benefit Period From the Card's Entries
content:
When a benefit period on a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card is closed, the allowance that period carried is read from the card's own load entries for it, and only where those are missing from the card's tier.

The allowance loaded for that period is the total of the loads posted for it, where more than one load was posted for the period; it is that load, where exactly one was posted for it; and it is the quarterly allowance the card's tier carries in every other case.

**Which entries are counted.** The loads posted for the period are the scheduled load entries and the extra load entries carrying that benefit period on the card's record; both kinds count, and both the count and the total are taken from them.

**Condition and result.**

- More than one load entry stands for the period: the allowance loaded for it is the total of them all.
- Exactly one load entry stands for the period: the allowance loaded for it is that entry.
- No load entry stands for the period: the allowance loaded for it is the quarterly allowance the card's tier carries.

**Worked through on hypothetical entries.** A period carrying a scheduled load of 135.00 USD and an extra load of 45.00 USD: more than one load was posted, so the allowance loaded for the period is 180.00 USD. The same period carrying the scheduled load alone: exactly one was posted, so it is 135.00 USD. A period carrying no load entry at all, on a card whose tier carries a quarterly allowance of 90.00 USD: the allowance loaded for it is 90.00 USD.
